title: Runbook: zero-downtime AKS node-pool upgrade to Kubernetes 1.30
objective: Produce an on-call runbook for upgrading the production AKS cluster's user node pools to Kubernetes 1.30 without dropping traffic, including pre-checks, surge/drain settings, stuck-drain handling and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Uses az CLI and kubectl 1.30 commands only

answers.audience: Platform SRE on-call engineers (comfortable with kubectl, new to AKS upgrades)
answers.backup_procedure: Velero schedule daily-cluster (namespaces + PVC snapshots), must show a Completed backup from the last 24h
answers.constraints: az CLI 2.6x, kubectl 1.30; no third-party upgrade tooling; must follow CHG-policy-7 (control plane before node pools).
answers.context: Production cluster aks-cooleng-prod-eus2 runs 1.29 with two user node pools (userpool1: 12 nodes, userpool2: 6 nodes). All tier-1 services have PDBs. Upgrades happen in the Tuesday 14:00-17:00 UTC change window.
